subject: Pipeline accountability grid + gap repair plan
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pipeline accountability grid + initial gaps

Team,

I pulled a quick draft coverage grid for our US quota motion and highlighted the top 20 deals by ARR. Attached is coverage_grid_draft.csv — it has the raw stage / ARR / expected close month / current win probability I pulled from HS.

Ask for today: please update the grid with a short note in the "next_step" column and a revised probability if you disagree with what I put. Focus on:
- Any deals you are willing to mark as commit for the weekly rollup
- Any deals that need escalation (legal/procurement blocking)
- One targeted action you will take this week to move deals from late-pipeline to commit

Timeline: I need everyone to update their rows by EOD today (Jul 14) so Finance can run a what-if on coverage for Friday's forecast sync.

Quick context: after the run-rate analysis, we are ~18% short to quota for the quarter if nothing converts. We need a clean commit list so we can model upside and put substantiated ask on the board.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior AE, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: coverage_grid_draft.csv (CSV, 45KB)]
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline accountability grid + initial gaps

Marcus — thanks for pulling this together. I made inline updates for the deals I own and attached a one-page runway snapshot (Q2_runway_snapshot.pdf) with conservative/likely/upside scenarios. Key notes from my updates: 

- NimbleSoft (RDW-2027-0091): Moved from "Negotiation" -> "Commit candidate". Procurement indicated they will send final SOW next week pending legal redline. I set probability to 75% and added next_step: "Confirm sign-off with Ops; schedule SOW review (owner: Marcus)".
- Helios Analytics: Stalled on procurement; moved to "Needs escalation" and added a note to loop Legal. Probability 20%.
- BrightLayer: No change — still in PoC, probability 35%, I added an ask for an in-person demo to accelerate.

I also added a short recommended action set for each commit candidate (column: short_action). Please treat the probability column as a reflection of your willingness to include the deal in commit.

On timing: EOD is tight for some folks given customer calls; can we extend to 5pm PT if anyone flags conflict? If that's ok, I'll still push my final action_tracker.csv by close of business.

On quoting your line: 
> after the run-rate analysis, we are ~18% short to quota for the quarter

I'm going to mobilize two mini-plays to cover that delta: 1) prioritize 3 mid-market ACV deals with high CLTV for commit, 2) accelerate one strategic upsell that has legal ready. Will note owners in action_tracker.

Laura Bennett
Sales Manager, Mid-Market
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Q2_runway_snapshot.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 09:58:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline accountability grid + initial gaps

Thanks Laura — this is helpful. Two quick items: 
1) Let's lock a 30-minute commit review today at 11:30am PT to finalize the rollup for Finance (calendar link below). Please bring any supporting docs (SOW draft, procurement emails).
2) Marcus — can you own the NimbleSoft SOW follow-up and confirm the internal Ops approver? If you can do that before the 11:30 sync, we can include it as a commit candidate.

I'll create the meeting invite and include HS record HS-54218 so Finance has the context.

Aditya
Director, Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference

[Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abc123-q2-commit-review]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>

Bcc: finance@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pipeline accountability grid + initial gaps — action tracker

Confirming the 11:30am PT sync — I've added the meeting to my calendar. Per the draft action_tracker.csv attached, owners and due dates: 

- Marcus Lin: NimbleSoft SOW follow-up / Ops approver confirmation — due Jul 15 EOD.
- Laura Bennett (me): BrightLayer in-person demo ask + POC milestone review — due Jul 20.
- Rishi Malhotra: Legal escalation packet for Helios Analytics — due Jul 16 morning.
- Aditya Rao: Finance model input (upside assumptions) — due Jul 15 noon.

Please update the action_tracker.csv if you take different owners. We'll use this as the source of truth for the Friday forecast tabletop.

Thanks everyone — see you at 11:30.

Laura Bennett
Sales Manager, Mid-Market
Redwood Inference
